scores.question: Which agreements can be terminated for convenience, without cause?
scores.answer:
The following agreements permit termination without cause:

- **Reseller Agreement:** PivX may terminate for convenience on at least 30 days’ written notice. [ADIANUTRITION,INC_04_01_2005-EX-10.D2-RESELLER AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **Strategic Alliance Agreement:** Either party may terminate at any time on 60 days’ advance written notice. [COOLTECHNOLOGIES,INC_10_25_2017-EX-10.71-Strategic Alliance Agreement.PDF p. 2]
- **Promotion Agreement:** Either party may terminate after the first three months on 30 days’ written notice. [CYBERIANOUTPOSTINC_07_09_1998-EX-10.13-PROMOTION AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]
- **Content License Agreement:** Rogers may terminate at any time on 60 days’ prior written notice. [EuromediaHoldingsCorp_20070215_10SB12G_EX-10.B(01)_525118_EX-10.B(01)_Content License Agreement.pdf p. 7]
- **Services Agreement:** Either party may terminate on at least 60 days’ written notice. [FEDERATEDGOVERNMENTINCOMESECURITIESINC_04_28_2020-EX-99.SERV AGREE-SERVICES AGREEMENT.pdf p. 1]
- **Distributor Agreement:** Either party may terminate for any reason or no reason on 90 days’ written notice. [ImineCorp_20180725_S-1_EX-10.5_11275970_EX-10.5_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 6]
- **Intellectual Property Agreement:** Party A may terminate at any time on 30 days’ written notice. [JINGWEIINTERNATIONALLTD_10_04_2007-EX-10.7-INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AGREEMENT.PDF p. 3]
- **Consulting Agreement:** The Company may terminate for any or no reason on 90 days’ written notice; the consultant may also terminate on 90 days’ written notice. [MEDALISTDIVERSIFIEDREIT,INC_05_18_2020-EX-10.1-CONSULTING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **Distributor Agreement:** Either party may terminate for any reason on six months’ prior written notice. [NANOPHASETECHNOLOGIESCORP_11_01_2005-EX-99.1-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 8]
- **Distributor Agreement:** Either ITS or COMWARE may terminate for any reason on 30 days’ written notice. [OPTIMIZEDTRANSPORTATIONMANAGEMENT,INC_07_26_2000-EX-6.6-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **Maintenance Agreement:** Either party may terminate at any time without liability on 180 days’ written notice. [UAGHINC_04_14_2004-EX-10.18-MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 1]
- **Operation and Maintenance Agreement:** Owner may terminate without cause on at least seven days’ prior written notice. [VERTEXENERGYINC_08_14_2014-EX-10.24-OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 9]
- **Manufacturing Design Marketing Agreement:** Section 8.3(a) contemplates manufacturer termination without cause, subject to cancellation charges, although its referenced Section 8.2 lists cause-based events. [Zounds Hearing, Inc. - MANUFACTURING DESIGN MARKETING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]

scores.question: Which agreements give a party audit rights?
expected: Zounds Hearing, Inc. - MANUFACTURING DESIGN MARKETING AGREEMENT.PDF
scores.answer:
The following agreements grant audit or accounting-examination rights:

- **PivX** may audit Detto’s books and records. [ADIANUTRITION,INC_04_01_2005-EX-10.D2-RESELLER AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **NAI** may have independent auditors audit Co-Host’s accounting records. [BEYONDCOMCORP_08_03_2000-EX-10.2-CO-HOSTING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 9]
- **Each party** may commission an audit concerning Retail Impressions or CNET Sales. [CYBERIANOUTPOSTINC_07_09_1998-EX-10.13-PROMOTION AGREEMENT.PDF p. 4]
- **Rogers** may audit Licensor’s records for compliance with the favorable-terms provision. [EuromediaHoldingsCorp_20070215_10SB12G_EX-10.B(01)_525118_EX-10.B(01)_Content License Agreement.pdf p. 8]
- **Go Call** may examine PageMaster’s books and records to verify promotional sales. [GOCALLINC_03_30_2000-EX-10.7-Promotion Agreement.PDF p. 2]
- **Either party** may audit the other’s agreement-related books and records. [HealthcentralCom_19991108_S-1A_EX-10.27_6623292_EX-10.27_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **JRVS** may audit Distributor’s books and records to verify reports. [ImineCorp_20180725_S-1_EX-10.5_11275970_EX-10.5_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **VerticalNet** may appoint an accountant to audit Impresse’s payment-related financial records. [ImpresseCorp_20000322_S-1A_EX-10.11_5199234_EX-10.11_Co-Branding Agreement.pdf p. 4]
- **ALFA AESAR** may commission an audit of NTC’s referral-related invoices and accounting records. [NANOPHASETECHNOLOGIESCORP_11_01_2005-EX-99.1-DISTRIBUTOR AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **NetGrocer** may appoint an accountant to inspect Excite’s payment-related records. [NETGROCERINC_07_31_1998-EX-10.15-SPONSORSHIP AGREEMENT.PDF p. 5]
- **E.piphany** may audit HSNS’s business records for contractual compliance. [OASYSMOBILE,INC_07_05_2001-EX-10.17-OUTSOURCING AGREEMENT.PDF p. 2]
- **Cisco’s audit rights** are expressly referenced and extended to Distributor’s compliance representations. [ScansourceInc_20190822_10-K_EX-10.39_11793959_EX-10.39_Distributor Agreement.pdf p. 2]
- **Owner** may audit Operator’s records and relevant contractor records. [VERTEXENERGYINC_08_14_2014-EX-10.24-OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT.PDF p. 15]
